heading: Propose motion designs that align with backend emotion categories for engineering efficiency.

blocks.html: Our backend integrates affective computing with Plutchik's Wheel of Emotions.
For engineering efficiency, I proposed to follow this same wheel of emotions and proposed to come up with 24 emotions, so that they can be quickly captured and rooted into those backend categories.
